notablePrerequisites: At least 2 charge counters on Spawning Pit.
description:
Pay {1}, removing 2 charge counters from Spawning Pit to create two 2/2 Spawn creature tokens.
Sacrifice one token to Ashnod's Altar to add {C}{C}.
Sacrifice the other token to Spawning Pit to put 2 charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.
